name: George Washington
note: Office vacant Mar 4 - Apr 30, 1789; government began before the president did

name: William Henry Harrison
note: Died in office after 31 days; never held office on a July 4

name: John Tyler
note: Expelled from the Whig Party Sept 1841; unaffiliated thereafter

name: Zachary Taylor
note: Legal term began Mar 4; sworn Mar 5 (Mar 4 was a Sunday). Died July 9, 1850, five days after his only July 4 in office

name: Abraham Lincoln
note: Assassinated in office

name: Andrew Johnson
note: Elected as a Democrat on the National Union ticket

name: Rutherford B. Hayes
note: Took the oath privately Mar 3, 1877; public ceremony Mar 5

name: James A. Garfield
note: Shot July 2, 1881; in office but incapacitated on July 4; died Sept 19

note: First of two non-consecutive terms

note: Second of two non-consecutive terms

name: William McKinley
note: Assassinated in office

name: Warren G. Harding
note: Died in office

name: Calvin Coolidge
note: Born on July 4; the only president whose birthday coincides with the sample date

name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
note: Died in office; longest tenure, 12 July 4ths

note: Assassinated in office
